stories.title: Community spaces bridge the connection gap for Canadians

en.title: Community spaces bridge the connection gap for Canadians
en.summary: Research from the YMCA of Greater Toronto demonstrates that in-person community spaces play an important role in fostering connections among Canadians.

stories.title: Rays clinch AL East and home-field advantage with 6-1 win over Yankees

en.title: Rays clinch AL East and home-field advantage with 6-1 win over Yankees
en.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays defeated the New York Yankees 6-1 in the second game of a doubleheader, securing the AL East Division title and home-field advantage for the playoffs.

stories.title: MLB scores: Rays clinch AL East and home-field advantage with 6-1 win over Yankees

en.title: MLB scores: Rays clinch AL East and home-field advantage with 6-1 win over Yankees
en.summary: Drew Rasmussen pitched effectively with 11 strikeouts as the Tampa Bay Rays defeated the New York Yankees 6-1 in a doubleheader game, clinching the AL East Division.

stories.title: Trump-backed Missouri congressional map returns to the Supreme Court for the third time

en.title: Trump-backed Missouri congressional map returns to the Supreme Court for the third time
en.summary: Missouri's congressional map dispute has returned to the U.S. Supreme Court for a third time after an appeals court ordered the reinstatement of districts supported by President Donald Trump.

stories.title: Rockies become the first team since the Mets from 1962-65 with 4 straight 100-loss seasons

en.title: Rockies become the first team since the Mets from 1962-65 with 4 straight 100-loss seasons
en.summary: The Colorado Rockies have achieved the unfortunate distinction of becoming the first Major League Baseball team since the 1962-1965 New York Mets to record four consecutive seasons with at least 100 losses.

stories.title: Diamondbacks beat Rockies 7-2, send Colorado to its 4th straight season of 100 or more losses

en.title: Diamondbacks beat Rockies 7-2, send Colorado to its 4th straight season of 100 or more losses
en.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks defeated the Colorado Rockies 7-2, with Nolan Arenado hitting a solo home run in the seventh inning. The loss extends Colorado's streak to four consecutive seasons with 100 or more defeats.

stories.title: Winnipeg Jets drop home pre-season finale 2-1 in OT to Oilers

en.title: Winnipeg Jets drop home pre-season finale 2-1 in OT to Oilers
en.summary: The Winnipeg Jets lost their home pre-season finale to the Edmonton Oilers in overtime by a score of 2-1. Alex Iafallo scored the Jets' only goal while goaltender Domenic DiVincentiis recorded 21 saves.

stories.title: Bennett Bridge crash brings Central Okanagan traffic to a standstill

en.title: Bennett Bridge crash brings Central Okanagan traffic to a standstill
en.summary: A crash on Bennett Bridge has caused significant traffic disruptions in Central Okanagan. The incident has prompted renewed demands from local officials and residents for construction of a second bridge across Okanagan Lake.

stories.title: Afternoon front page: Synagogue shooting suspect dies; CBC journalist has run-in with protesters outside Yom Kippur service; and more

en.title: Afternoon front page: Synagogue shooting suspect dies; CBC journalist has run-in with protesters outside Yom Kippur service; and more
en.summary: A suspect in a synagogue shooting has died, and a CBC journalist encountered protesters near a Yom Kippur service, among other developing stories.

stories.title: Suspect in Belleville synagogue shooting was removed from military service, sources say

en.title: Suspect in Belleville synagogue shooting was removed from military service, sources say
en.summary: The alleged shooter in a Belleville synagogue incident was discharged from the military after refusing to take the COVID-19 vaccine, according to sources familiar with the matter.

stories.title: Suspect in shooting outside Belleville synagogue has died, police watchdog says

en.title: Suspect in shooting outside Belleville synagogue has died, police watchdog says
en.summary: The suspect in a shooting incident outside a Belleville synagogue has been identified as 29-year-old Sean Ward of Quinte West and has died, according to police authorities.

stories.title: Telesat faces showdown with American creditors over debt
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Telesat faces showdown with American creditors over debt
en.summary: Telesat, which was promoted to foreign investors at an investment summit, faces potential default on its loans unless it reaches an agreement with American creditors.

stories.title: Pickering nuclear station shuts down for refurbishment, raising fears of higher power prices
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Pickering nuclear station shuts down for refurbishment, raising fears of higher power prices
en.summary: Ontario's Pickering nuclear station is closing for refurbishment, requiring gas-fired plants with higher operating costs to increase electricity generation. This shift is expected to put upward pressure on provincial power prices.

stories.title: Diesel prices hit record highs as wars squeeze global supplies
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Diesel prices hit record highs as wars squeeze global supplies
en.summary: Global diesel prices have reached record levels due to conflicts reducing exports from Gulf countries. Net exports from these regions have fallen to approximately one-quarter of their pre-war levels.

stories.title: Ontario-backed High Art Capital pays $22.3-million for 43 unsold Toronto condo units
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Ontario-backed High Art Capital pays $22.3-million for 43 unsold Toronto condo units
en.summary: Ontario-backed High Art Capital purchased 43 unsold Toronto condominium units for $22.3 million in a bulk sale below market rate. This represents the fund's first transaction and is among few such publicly disclosed deals.

stories.title: Labour Code changes will increase transparency amid high-profile bargaining disputes, Hajdu says
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Labour Code changes will increase transparency amid high-profile bargaining disputes, Hajdu says
en.summary: Labour Code amendments aim to enhance transparency during major labour negotiations, according to Hajdu. Union representatives contend the changes could diminish workers' right to strike.
